SOC 3 REPORT

Report of Independent Service Auditors on a Description of a Service
Organization's System and the Suitability of the Design and Operating
Effectiveness of Controls Relevant to Security, Availability, and
Confidentiality.

This SOC 3 report covers the service organization's system throughout the
report period from January 1, 2026 to December 31, 2026.

In our opinion, the controls were suitably designed and operated effectively
throughout the specified period based on the applicable trust services criteria.
